verdicts.note: All three conditions (PIN match, active line status, balance due <= 100.00) and refusal outcome with explanation match the formal rule.
Lower monthly price and contract end date in the future (after today) triggers opening a change request with reason early_downgrade, exactly matching R2.
The policy requires matching the service postcode on file before making any changes, and specifies to make no change if it doesn't match or cannot be provided.
The policy states the account must be active, and suspended or closed accounts cannot have a plan.
The policy specifies the bill must currently be overdue.
The policy specifies that if the account already has a plan, decline.
The policy specifies between 2 and 6 monthly instalments and bill amount of at least 60.00.
The policy requires confirming identity where the date of birth given by caller matches the one on file, and if not or if unable to give it, to make no change and refuse.
The policy specifies that the member's plan must be active, otherwise claims cannot be paid.
The policy requires claim status to be ready_for_payment, otherwise it cannot be paid.
The policy states the date of service must be no more than 180 days before today, matching days_between(clm.service_date, today) <= 180 for approval and > 180 for refusal.
The policy specifies claims billed above 5000.00 cannot be released, matching clm.billed_amount > 5000 -> refuse.
Matches R1: asks for passenger's date of birth, must match record on file, otherwise make no change (refuse).
Matches R2: booking must be confirmed, fare class must not be basic, new flight must have same route (origin and destination) and at least 1 seat available, otherwise not allowed.
Matches R3: current flight departs in fewer than 3 days from today triggers approval request with reason 'late_change'.
The policy requires the reservation to be confirmed and currently booked in a standard room, declining if either condition fails.
The policy requires the request to be at least 2 days before check-in, clarifying that check-in today or tomorrow is too late, matching days_between(today, check_in) >= 2.
The policy requires the points balance to cover 4000 points per night of the stay.
The policy requires at least one deluxe room available in the pool (rooms_available of 1 or more).
The policy requires the customer account to be active and notes blocked customers cannot upgrade, matching cust.status != 'active' -> refuse.
The policy states the reservation must still be booked and picked up, cancelled, or completed reservations cannot be upgraded, matching res.status != 'booked' -> refuse.
The policy requires the request to be at least 2 days before pickup date and to decline closer than that, matching days_between(today, res.pickup_date) < 2 -> refuse.
The policy requires the new class to be a higher tier rank than the current class and declines same or lower tier, matching new.tier_rank <= cur.tier_rank -> refuse.
The policy requires at least one unit available in the new class, matching new.units_available < 1 -> refuse.
The policy directs opening an approval request with reason 'luxury_upgrade' when the new class is luxury, matching new.class_code == 'luxury' -> approval.
The policy requires the enrollment to have status 'enrolled' and explicitly disallows any other status.
The policy requires the withdrawal to be made on or before the course's withdrawal deadline, refusing it after that date.
The policy requires the caller's date of birth to match the one on file, and to make no change if it does not match or cannot be provided.
The policy states the permit must have status active, and cannot be renewed if expired or revoked.
The policy specifies that residents who owe more than 20.00 in unpaid parking fines cannot renew.
The policy specifies that renewal opens 60 days before expiry and to decline if it expires more than 60 days from today.
The policy requires the membership to be active and notes frozen or cancelled memberships cannot be frozen, refusing otherwise.
The policy requires balance due to not be above 0.00, refusing otherwise.
The policy explicitly states a membership can be frozen at most twice per calendar year based on the freeze count, refusing if exceeded.
The policy states a freeze can last at most 6 months and requests for more are declined.
The policy states if the contract ends in less than 60 days from today, it cannot be frozen.
The policy specifies that freezes of more than 3 and up to 6 months require opening a manager approval request for the requested months instead of direct application.
The policy requires the patient account to be active, declining inactive accounts.
Prescription expiry date must not be before today and must have at least one refill remaining (refills_remaining > 0).
Requires at least 21 days since last fill and at most 30 days supply requested; requests exceeding 30 days are declined.
Controlled substances open a pharmacist review with reason controlled_substance.
Requires the account to be active, declining suspended/closed accounts.
Declines if account balance due is strictly greater than 25.00.
Requires the requested plan to currently be offered for sale.
Requires requested plan speed to be faster than current speed; same or slower declined.
Declines if upgrades in the last 12 months is at least 2 ('at most twice in any 12 months. If it already has two upgrades in that period, decline').
Checks if requested plan speed > line max speed, opening a line check request with reason 'line_capacity'.
The policy requires the billing postal code given by the customer to match the account before proceeding, refusing/making no change if it does not match.
The policy specifies the item must still be in delivered status and an item already returned cannot be returned again.
The policy specifies final-sale items cannot be returned.
The policy specifies returns must be requested within 30 days of the delivery date.
The policy specifies that if the reason is changed mind, the return must be requested within 14 days of delivery.
All three refuse conditions (refund_status != 'none', placed > 7 days ago, req.amount > order_total) and the refuse outcome match exactly.
Matches req.amount > 30 resulting in create_review_request with reason 'high_value' and the requested amount.
The policy requires verifying that the delivery postcode matches the recipient postcode on file, refusing changes if missing or mismatched.
The policy explicitly limits rescheduling to parcels with status in_depot or scheduled.
The policy specifies the new date must be between 1 and 14 days after today and that a parcel can be rescheduled at most twice (declining if already rescheduled twice).
The policy requires date of birth verification matching records and that the lease must be active, refusing the request (making no change / cannot register) if either fails.
The policy directs opening a pet review request with species and weight if the pet weighs > 25 kg or if the lease already has 2 or more pets registered.
The policy requires verifying that the caller's date of birth matches the one on file, declining/making no change if it does not or cannot be given.
The policy specifies that the employee's status must be active, declining those on leave or terminated.
The policy specifies that requested days may not exceed the current PTO balance.
The policy specifies a maximum of 10 working days and that the start date must be at least 2 days after today (explicitly noting exactly 2 days is acceptable).
The policy specifies that the start date cannot fall inside the blackout period, including both the start and end dates.
The policy requires the fee to still be in status charged, noting already reversed fees cannot be reversed again, declining if not.
The policy specifies the fee must have been charged no more than 60 days before today, declining older fees (days > 60).
The policy specifies that a member who already has two or more reversals_ytd cannot receive another (declined if reversals_ytd >= 2).
The policy requires the policy to be active, declining any non-active policies.
Wellness claims are excluded from approval.
The claim amount must not exceed the remaining annual limit (annual limit minus used amount); otherwise it is declined.
Identity check requires caller's DOB to match owner's DOB on file, refusing (making no change) if it does not match or cannot be provided.
Requires registration status to be active, blocking/refusing renewal otherwise.
Specifies no unpaid fines (any amount above 0.00 blocks renewal), matching veh.fines_due > 0 -> refuse.
Requires passed emissions test and insurance must not have expired before today (days_between(today, insurance_expiry) < 0).
Requires opening a staff review request with reason transfer_pending if ownership transfer is pending, instead of renewing.
The policy requires status confirmed in step 1, refusing otherwise.
The policy requires the member's account to be active in step 2, refusing otherwise.
The policy states the booking must start at least 2 days after today, refusing anything starting sooner (< 2 days).
The policy refuses cancellation if the overdue balance is above 50.00.
The policy specifies boardroom bookings starting in less than 7 days cannot be cancelled.
The policy specifies opening an approval request with reason external_event for external events.
The policy requires confirming the caller's billing postal code matches the account before making any change.
The policy specifies that the order must still be in paid status, otherwise no refund is allowed.
The policy explicitly states that if the event is less than 7 days away (or has passed), no refund is given, and exactly 7 days away qualifies.
The policy requires caller's date of birth to match the date of birth on file, declining otherwise.
The policy specifies the appointment must have status scheduled, declining otherwise.
The policy requires the new slot to be open, on a date after today (days_between > 0), and at least as long as the appointment in minutes, declining otherwise.
The policy specifies if the appointment is today or tomorrow (fewer than 2 days from today), open an approval request with reason 'late_change'.
The policy matches the condition that a bill already adjusted or an account with two leak credits cannot receive another, leading to refusal.
The policy accurately states that usage must be at least double the average usage in gallons, otherwise it does not qualify.
The policy requires the account to be active, declining suspended or closed accounts.
The policy requires balance due to be 0 / no unpaid balance, matching acct.balance_due > 0.
The policy specifies only annual subscriptions qualify and monthly are declined, matching sub.billing_cycle != 'annual'.
The policy states the new seat count must be lower than current and at least 3, matching req.new_seats < 3 or req.new_seats >= sub.seats.
The policy specifies to decline if renewal date is less than 30 days away, matching days_between(today, sub.renewal_date) < 30.
The policy directs opening an approval request if the prorated credit is more than 500.00, matching > 500 and outcome approval.
